findings.summary: Sanitized-human-decision authenticity is an upstream control not defined by this public path.
Same-process reconstruction can duplicate intermediate approval artifacts but cannot produce a second eligibility or accounting attempt.
Prompt provenance is shape and continuity validated but not independently resolved at its repository commit.
An unregistered future _ClosedArtifact subclass would require an explicit seal-table membership guard.
Qualification factory accepts any existing absolute directory and should later exclude the live registry root for availability hardening.
Mutation floors permit coverage shrinkage even though any unexpected mutation pass remains exact-fail.
